trace.question: Please list the constructor names with 0 points at race 291.

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291
  AND cr.points = 0

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291
  AND cr.points = 0
trace.answer: Constructors scoring 0 points at race 291 were: Minardi, Dallara, Larrousse, Team Lotus, Fondmetal, March, Tyrrell, Ligier, Jordan, McLaren, and Brabham.
